# Skay Crafts

> Skay Crafts is a software development and digital solutions company, founded on 16 April 2026 by Akshaya A and Syed Muhith Ibrahim R. It builds custom software, websites, brand identities, digital marketing, SEO and AI-powered systems for businesses. Tagline: "Building Beyond Limits."

Skay Crafts works with startups, local businesses and growing companies. It builds each solution around a business's own workflow rather than a generic template, and handles development, design, SEO and marketing as one team.

## Services

- **Software**: custom business software, including dashboards, billing and invoicing, booking systems, customer management and internal tools.
- **Websites**: high-performance websites and web applications, including business sites, booking sites, portfolios, e-commerce and customer portals.
- **Branding & Design**: logo and identity design, print collateral, signage and vehicle graphics such as name boards, stickering and car badges.
- **Digital marketing**: social media marketing, paid campaigns, content and customer acquisition.
- **SEO**: technical and on-page SEO, local SEO, and Google Business Profile setup and optimisation.
- **AI & Automation**: AI-powered workflows, integrations and intelligent business tools.

## Projects

- [PlayZoo](https://playzoo.in/): indoor gaming and pickleball centre in Chennai. Website and digital marketing.
- [CornerStay](https://cornerstay.vercel.app/): serviced apartments in Coimbatore. Website and booking system.
- [The Roost](https://theroost-production.up.railway.app/): boutique stay in Nungambakkam, Chennai. Website and technology solutions.
- [Farook J Basha](https://farookjbashadop.com/): portfolio website for a cinematographer and director of photography.
- [HiOnWheels](https://hionwheels.com/): luxury pre-owned car dealership in Chennai. Website.
- HiOnWheels: automotive brand. Logo design, vehicle graphics (name boards, stickering, car badges) and digital marketing.
- VAPR: in development.

## Technology

React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Supabase, REST APIs, cloud hosting, and AI-assisted development tools. The stack is chosen per project.
